theme_description: A documentation theme for developers and technical teams — ideal for API references, product manuals, and technical guides.

generic.name: Basic information settings for the site

logo_url.label: Logo image
logo_url.info: When set, the header shows this logo only; otherwise the site favicon and site name are shown.

left_sidebar_width.label: Left sidebar width
left_sidebar_width.info: Used on documentation pages with a sidebar. Default: 300px.

api_base_url_hint.label: API Base URL hint
api_base_url_hint.info: Shown in the OpenAPI reference page header, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1

enable_ai_chat_search.label: Enable AI Chat Search
enable_ai_chat_search.info: When enabled, the search page shows the AI assistant. Uncheck to hide it. The site must still have AI search capability enabled.

ai_search_completed_text.label: AI Completion Text
ai_search_completed_text.info: Add a sentence after AI completes the answer

show_page_tools_dropdown.label: Show Copy for LLM / MCP tools dropdown

footer_menu_html.label: Footer HTML
footer_menu_html.info: The entire footer content (copyright, ICP, etc.). Supports HTML and limited TailwindCSS.
footer_menu_html.placeholder: Usually used for footer nav, friendly links, copyright and ICP notice

header_menu_html.label: Insert HTML code into the top navigation area
header_menu_html.info: Support HTML tags and limited TailwindCSS style code
header_menu_html.placeholder: Usually insert navigation links from other company websites here

head_html.label: Head Meta HTML Code
head_html.info: This part of the content will be embedded in the<head>tag of the site, please use standard HTML format

features_one.label: Channel right sidebar HTML
features_one.info: Right column on page.channel — e.g. SDK downloads or related links

lucide_icons.label: Allowed Lucide icon names
lucide_icons.info: One kebab-case icon name per line (e.g. folder, book-open). Page and channel templates use this list for the sidebar icon dropdown. Icons must match the theme JS bundle; adding names here without updating the bundle will not render on the site.

search_hot_keywords.label: Popular searches
search_hot_keywords.info: Used on home hero and site search page. One keyword per line.

hero_image_url.label: Background image
hero_image_url.info: Hero background in the content area; falls back to the theme default

hero_font_color.label: Hero text color
hero_font_color.info: Defaults to black; use #ffffff on a dark hero image

featured_count.label: Number of featured cards
featured_count.info: Taken from top-level items in the site navigation menu

show_chapter_prefix.label: Show “Chapter N —” prefix on top-level items

chapter_prefix.label: Chapter prefix label
chapter_prefix.info: Shown as the level-1 block label (e.g. SECTION 1). Use words like Section or Chapter.

show_page_numbers.label: Show page numbers
show_page_numbers.info: Sequential numbers in TOC order (not print page numbers)

hero_image_url.label: Hero background image
hero_image_url.info: 16:9 image at full width with natural height; fades to fully transparent toward the bottom

hero_font_color.label: Hero text color
hero_font_color.info: Applies to the title, subtitle, and popular search tags in the hero section (e.g. #ffffff on a dark background)

featured_count.label: Number of featured guides
featured_count.info: Taken from the first items in the site navigation menu

categories_max_count.label: Maximum categories to show
categories_max_count.info: Remaining nav menu items after featured guides; order follows navigation

content.label: content
content.info: Synchronize from data source, non editable

content.label: content
content.info: Synchronize from data source, non editable

title.label: Title
title.info: Synced from the knowledge base; not editable here

description.label: Description
description.info: Optional page summary for the article header

nav_lucide_icon.label: Sidebar section icon
nav_lucide_icon.info: Lucide icon for this page when it appears as a top-level sidebar group (no link, expand/collapse only)

api_document.label: OpenAPI document
api_document.info: Inline OpenAPI 3.x JSON/YAML — use either this or OpenAPI document URL

api_document_url.label: OpenAPI document URL
api_document_url.info: Remote OpenAPI spec URL — use either this or inline OpenAPI document

weixin_app_id.label: Developer ID (AppID)
weixin_app_id.info: WeChat official account/setting and development/development interface management

weixin_app_secret.label: Developer Password (AppSecret)
weixin_app_secret.info: Obtain from WeChat Official Account / Settings & Development / Development Interface Management

weixin_enabled.label: Do you want to enable WeChat sharing
weixin_enabled.info:
Provide the ability to share site pages on WeChat
Please configure the IP whitelist (ip: ${service_ip}) in the WeChat official account. After configuration, there will be a period of delay in effectiveness.
Check whether WeChat sharing permission is enabled, WeChat official account/setting and development/development interface management:

weixin_debug.label: Do you want to enable debug prompt
weixin_debug.info: Please only enable this option during the configuration phase; If WeChat sharing is not configured correctly when accessing the front-end site after activation, an error message will be automatically prompted
